findings.title: No test exercises the real rustls CA/SNI client path anymore.
findings.body:
Before this change, `sends_requests_with_custom_ca_and_sni` started a local TLS server with a runtime-generated CA, and `accepts_inline_and_file_ca` parsed a real PEM. Together they exercised the `impl TokenProxyClient for reqwest::Client` code: custom root loading, SNI, and resolved-address overrides.

Now both real tests are `#[ignore]` and need a live AKS identity-binding pod. The replacement tests swap in `MockTokenProxyClient`/`MockCaClient`, so the `reqwest::Client` builder and its CA parsing never run in CI. A regression in the TLS setup, the very code whose feature gating this PR changes, would go unnoticed.

The linked issue only asks to move the feature. Keep a non-ignored test that builds the real rustls client against a locally generated CA and server.

A runtime-generated CA is not a checked-in CA. If openssl must stay optional, `rcgen` can generate it.

findings.title: Rewrite of the live-test provisioning script is unrelated to the feature-flag issue.

held.title: Disabling azure_identity default features in azure_core_test is outside the request.
held.body:
`azure_core_test` now depends on `azure_identity` with `default-features = false`. That drops `azure_core/default` and `reqwest_rustls` from this crate's dependency graph, which the linked issue does not cover.

Any test or helper in `azure_core_test` that relied on azure_identity's default transport or its rustls TLS can stop compiling or fail at runtime. The trigger is building it alone or in a workspace subset where no other crate enables those features. I could not see whether `azure_core_test` needs them.

Revert the change, or explain it and verify `cargo test -p azure_core_test` builds and runs on its own.

held.title: IMDS live helper now errors instead of skipping when IMDS is unavailable.
held.body:
`run_imds_live_test` used to print a skip message and return `Ok(())` when `IDENTITY_IMDS_AVAILABLE` was unset. It now returns an error.

Only `imds_system_assigned_live` was changed to `#[ignore]` here. Any other caller still marked `#[recorded::test(live)]`, such as a user-assigned IMDS live test, will now fail in every live run on hosts without IMDS. I could not see whether such callers exist. This test-infrastructure change is also not part of the requested feature fix.

Mark every caller `#[ignore]` as well, or restore the skip behaviour.
